name: Smoky Tuna-Cucumber Sandwich with Fennel, Arugula & Pistachio Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ lemon
1 fennel bulb
½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula
½ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two medium bowls (set one bowl aside for the salad).
Add yogurt, mayo, Dijon, and spices to the remaining bowl with the parsley. Stir to combine the creamy dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
Dijon mustard
½ tsp smoked paprika
salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the creamy dressing, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine the tuna salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (120 g) can chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemon into the second bowl with the parsley. Add oil, Dijon, honey, and salt, then whisk to combine the salad dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
Dijon mustard
1 tsp honey
salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the salad dressing.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds.
Toast bread if desired. Divide tuna salad between half of the slices and spread out in an even layer. Layer with cucumber, close sandwiches with remaining slices of bread, and cut in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
